per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should adhere to corporate UI standards and use the corporate component library for consistency in fonts, controls, and spacing.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should ensure accessibility compliance, including proper color choices and keyboard navigation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should provide a response time of around five seconds for basic transitions like list to detail or switching screens.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should not rely on local copies of authoritative transaction and cardmember information, but should cache non-authoritative data for performance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should ensure that all balance adjustments are handled through the Posting and Billing system to maintain ledger consistency.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System. This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant's accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should ensure idempotency for adjustment submissions to prevent duplicate adjustments.
The application should provide a detailed audit trail for all changes, including who made the change, when, what was changed, and why.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should support up to three hundred fifty concurrent users to cover peak call-center load.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should be available round-the-clock, with scheduled maintenance windows for downtime.
The application should provide dashboards for monitoring response times, queue lengths, CPU and DB metrics, and success/failure rates for integrations.
The application should provide clear, user-friendly messages for failed operations and include retry logic and a way to reconcile failed operations later.
The application should include a dead-letter or retry queue and an operations view for manual reconciliation of failed transactions.
The application should document the exact definition of 'concurrent users' and confirm maintenance windows precisely with ops.
The application should get the expected SLAs from the Statement and Cardmember teams to design caching and retries appropriately.
